scope: 12 synthetic cases, 4 per expected class; source corpus quality only; no production effect

cases.rationale: Same cause, applicability and corrective action as P1.
Refines the existing configuration-base procedure with the base of embedded relative references; retain project-root handling for the main file.
Content-schema failure after correct path resolution; requires input validation/correction, not another path-base rule.
Omitted continuation token and exact transmission are already covered by P2.
Adds the concrete query serialization step for opaque tokens while retaining the same client transmission cause and pagination procedure.
Server nonprogress despite correct token requires a separate no-progress termination procedure; it must not overwrite client token transmission guidance.
Exactly the confirmed UTF-8 decoding failure already covered by P3.
Refines the same single UTF-8 input decode with precise leading-BOM handling; preserve interior characters and original decoding discipline.
Producer serialization failure with correct consumer decoding; separate procedure, not an encoding fix.
Terminal retryable upstream failure and bounded same-input retry are fully covered by P4.
Refines the existing allowed retry with advertised delay; must retain attempt count and deadline and must not turn this into a general permission to retry.
Nonretryable input-schema error requires input repair, not transient-source retry or overwriting P4.
